task: Which ten current S&P 500 companies generated the most free cash flow in their latest reported fiscal year? Show the cash-flow components and reporting dates.
context: Current membership snapshot, latest available annual statements, USD. Fiscal years may differ; retain their actual period-end dates.
Free cash flow is operating cash flow less cash capex, with capex shown as a positive outflow. Return a saved table only; no dashboard is requested.

outputs.name: cash_flow_leaders
outputs.description: Top ten positive free-cash-flow companies, descending FCF, one row per company. Preserve genuine loading/coverage limitations.

schema.name: capex
schema.description: Capital expenditure as a positive cash outflow.

schema.name: free_cash_flow
schema.description: Operating cash flow minus positive capex.
